author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for 3D Printable Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay. Apply through official BambooHR hiring page linked in bio. Do not apply via Instagram DMs or comments.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists and More for Studio Projects
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. Looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, etc. Paid positions. Send professional email to whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, portfolio, rates, turnaround, software, payment method. No deadline, rolling acceptance. Absolutely no AI.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Looking for talented artists for upcoming stationery collection: journals, stickers, washi tapes, pens. Chubby characters, pastel doodles. Apply by following, commenting with emoji, DM portfolio or form in bio, or email info@youngonion.in.

author: philfalcowrites
title: Paid Comic Work: Artist for Transphoria Anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights. Application Deadline: December 21, 2026. Link in bio.

author: kavanaghgareth
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Details via @cutawaycomics. Send portfolio. Comments indicate deadline around Nov 29.
